FX-GRADE6-001.says: A whole grade, every section on and written: D-1007's own picture.

FX-GRADE6-002.says: The same with Basic Correction off: no white balance, tone or saturation; the rest as FX-GRADE6-001.

FX-GRADE6-003.says: Creative off: no look, faded film, sharpen, vibrance or tints.

FX-GRADE6-004.says: Curves off: the S curve and the hue-versus-hue curve not drawn.

FX-GRADE6-005.says: Color Wheels off: the shadows' blue push and the midtones' darkening not drawn.

FX-GRADE6-006.says: HSL Secondary off: the reds keep their colour.

FX-GRADE6-007.says: Vignette off: the corners no darker.

FX-GRADE6-008.says: Every section off: the drawing exactly as it is.

FX-GRADE6-009.says: Show Key Color/Gray with HSL Secondary off: the view goes with the section, and the vignette is drawn again.

FX-GRADE6-010.says: A D-1007 file with no switches: every section on, FX-GRADE6-001's picture.

FX-GRADE6-011.says: Curves' switch "yes", not "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
